description: A dramatically scaled, tonal living room with soaring double-height ceilings. Two floor-to-ceiling windows span the full back wall from near-floor to high ceiling, dressed with layered curtains: sheer white panels filter the bright daylight streaming through, overlaid with heavy warm taupe linen drapery panels on each side. The walls are smooth warm greige plaster. Two matching curved kidney-shaped sofas in cream bouclé are positioned symmetrically facing each other around a central seating island, each dressed with a single round cylindrical bolster pillow. The floor features a large circular sculpted area rug with concentric raised ridges in ivory and cream tones, creating a meditative, ripple-like relief pattern. Two coffee tables occupy the center zone: a rectangular black stone table and a smaller organic-edge stone table stacked loosely together hold a slim glass bud vase with dried pale grasses and a small round candle in a ceramic vessel. A low round olive-green wool ottoman sits in the foreground between the sofas. Soft warm light glows from a central overhead source, pooling warmly over the seating group. The overall palette is a single-tone study in cream, warm white, taupe, and a single punctuation of deep olive-green. The mood is serene, gallery-minimalist, and Japanese-influenced. Camera is at standing eye-level, centered and level, wide establishing view capturing the full symmetrical seating group and back window wall.
